# Paradex | Documentation

## Instructions for AI Agents

- For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
- For section-specific indexes, append `/llms.txt` to any section URL
- For AI client integration (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), connect to the MCP server at https://docs.paradex.trade/_mcp/server

If you only need market data (no trading), you can skip the private key step and go straight to your client's setup page from the [Quickstart guide](/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/quickstart).
- [ChatGPT Desktop](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/chatgpt-desktop.md): Connect the Paradex MCP server to ChatGPT Desktop in a few steps.
- [Claude Code CLI](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/claude-code.md): Connect the Paradex MCP server to Claude Code in a few steps.
- [Claude Desktop](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/claude-desktop.md): Connect the Paradex MCP server to Claude Desktop in a few steps.
- [Codex CLI](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/codex-cli.md): Connect the Paradex MCP server to Codex CLI in a few steps.
- [Cursor](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/cursor.md): Connect the Paradex MCP server to Cursor in a few steps.
- [Gemini CLI](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/gemini-cli.md): Connect the Paradex MCP server to Gemini CLI in a few steps.
- [VS Code (GitHub Copilot)](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/vscode.md): Connect the Paradex MCP server to VS Code in a few steps.
- [Windsurf](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/windsurf.md): Connect the Paradex MCP server to Windsurf in a few steps.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp/troubleshooting.md): Common issues and fixes when connecting the Paradex MCP server to your AI client.
- [Remote MCP quickstart](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/remote-mcp/quickstart.md): Deploy the Paradex MCP server to a cloud platform and connect your AI client via a public URL.
- [Railway](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/remote-mcp/railway.md): The quickest path to a permanent URL. Railway auto-detects the Dockerfile and handles TLS, routing, and restarts.
- [Render](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/remote-mcp/render.md): Similar to Railway with a free tier. Free services spin down after 15 minutes of inactivity and have a cold start (~30 s) on the next request.
- [Fly.io](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/remote-mcp/flyio.md): More setup than Railway or Render, but gives fine-grained control over region, scaling, and resources.
- [AWS Lambda](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/remote-mcp/aws-lambda.md): Serverless deployment with no idle cost that scales automatically.
- [Docker / VPS](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/remote-mcp/docker-vps.md): Run on any machine that can serve HTTPS — a DigitalOcean Droplet, Hetzner VPS, etc.
- [Quickstart guide](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/paradex-hosted-mcp/quickstart.md): The simplest way to get started — connect directly to the Paradex-hosted MCP server with no local install or cloud deployment.
- [Claude.ai (Web)](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/paradex-hosted-mcp/claudeai.md): Connect to the Paradex-hosted MCP server from Claude.ai in a few steps.
- [ChatGPT Desktop](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/paradex-hosted-mcp/chatgpt.md): Connect to the Paradex-hosted MCP server from ChatGPT Desktop in a few steps.
- [Smithery](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/paradex-hosted-mcp/smithery.md): Use Smithery's guided setup to connect to the Paradex-hosted MCP server.
- [Other Clients](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/paradex-hosted-mcp/other-clients.md): Connect any MCP-compatible AI client to the Paradex-hosted MCP server.
- [CLI](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/cli.md)
- [Agentic Skills](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/agentic-skills.md)
- [Available resources](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp-reference/resources.md): Resources are read-only data sources that your AI assistant can access in the background. Unlike [tools](/agentic-ai-hub/mcp-reference/tools) (which are called on demand), resources provide always-available context.
- [Available tools](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp-reference/tools.md): Tools are actions your AI assistant can perform when you ask it to — like fetching market data, placing orders, or checking your account. You don't need to call these directly; just ask your assistant in plain language and it will use the right tool automatically.
- [Built-in analysis prompts](https://docs.paradex.trade/agentic-ai-hub/mcp-reference/prompts.md): Prompts are ready-made conversation starters for common trading tasks. Instead of figuring out what to ask, you can use these as starting points — your AI assistant will follow a structured workflow to give you a thorough analysis.
